questions.owner_question: What do you deal in?
questions.customer_question: Do you have open plots?

questions.owner_question: Are you the builder / developer, or an agent?
questions.customer_question: Are you the builder?

questions.owner_question: What are your plot rates (per square yard, gunta or acre), and the extra for east / north facing or corner plots?
questions.customer_question: What is the rate per yard?

questions.owner_question: Which approvals do your projects have (HMDA / DTCP / RERA with LP and RERA numbers), or are they GP layouts or farm plots? Please give the numbers so buyers can check them.
questions.customer_question: Is this venture HMDA approved?

questions.owner_question: Can buyers see the title documents (30-year link documents, EC), is the survey number sub-divided, and is the land free of the prohibited list (22A), assigned, endowment, waqf or lake FTL / buffer issues?
questions.customer_question: Is this land clear of FTL?

questions.owner_question: For flats, what is the rate per sft, and what is the all-inclusive price (parking, amenities, corpus fund, GST, registration)?
questions.customer_question: What is the full price of a 2BHK?

questions.owner_question: Are the flats ready to move (with occupancy certificate), or when is handover?
questions.customer_question: Is OC received?

questions.owner_question: For rentals, what are the usual rent, maintenance, advance (how many months) and your brokerage?
questions.customer_question: How much is a 2BHK rent?

questions.owner_question: Is LRS paid, and can buyers get building permission now?
questions.customer_question: Can I start building right away?

questions.owner_question: Which banks give loans on your projects, and how is registration done (charges, spot registration)?
questions.customer_question: Will SBI give a loan here?

questions.owner_question: Do you arrange free site visits with pick-up and drop?
questions.customer_question: Can you take us to see the venture on Sunday?

questions.owner_question: What are the super built-up area, carpet area and UDS (land share) of your flats, how many flats per floor (no shared walls, ventilation), and are they vastu compliant (no bad street focus)?
questions.customer_question: What is the carpet area?

questions.owner_question: Is there anything nearby buyers should know (graveyard, high-tension lines, nala), and do you fence and guard the venture and handle disputes after sale?
questions.customer_question: Is there an HT line over the plot?

questions.owner_question: How are your flats built (red bricks, AAC blocks, Mivan), how deep is the borewell and what about summer water, and what parking does each flat get (covered, direct drive-in or back-to-back)?
questions.customer_question: Is the parking back-to-back?

questions.owner_question: If handover is delayed, what compensation does the agreement give (for example rent)?
questions.customer_question: What if the flat is delayed?

questions.owner_question: Do you sell landowner-share flats, and are they registered the same way as the builder's?
questions.customer_question: Is this a landowner share flat?

questions.owner_question: Which houses allow bachelors, pets or non-veg cooking, and what about water and the owner living in the same building?
questions.customer_question: Do they allow bachelors?

questions.owner_question: In your rentals, who pays for repairs (motor, geyser, plumbing), what is cut from the advance when leaving (painting), and does each house have its own electricity meter?
questions.customer_question: Will the owner cut painting charges from my advance?

questions.owner_question: Do you help with the rental agreement and tenant police verification?
questions.customer_question: Will you make the rent agreement?

questions.owner_question: Which languages can your staff speak?
questions.customer_question: Does anyone speak Hindi?

questions.owner_question: Please share your Google reviews link, if you have one.
questions.customer_question: Where can I see your reviews?
